title: The failure spreads
detail: Midway stop at 3:17, O'Hare holding at 3:21, diversion recovery at 3:30; Boston, Potomac and Washington Center report frequency problems; Chicago goes "ATC zero"

title: Chicago Center equipment outage
detail: Advisory 114 sets drop times for a Chicago Center (ZAU) equipment outage

title: International flights trickle out
detail: New York, Philadelphia and Bay Area oceanic departures released; Canada stops US-bound flights

title: Stop extended to 11 PM
detail: Advisory 120 cites "communications failure"; one Potomac route eased, a possible first release step

title: Still no domestic restart
detail: Next FAA planning call 7:15 PM; stop listed through 11 PM

title: Still stopped after 7:15 call
detail: Stop listed to 11 PM ET; next FAA planning webinar 9:15 PM ET; DCA closed to diversions
